// Recorder for newapi-recorded.jsonl. Copy this file into the `service`
// package of the original New API service checkout (as record_parity_test.go) and run:
//
//	INTELLIGENCE_JUDGE_DIR=<dir with model.json and references.json> \
//	PARITY_CASES=<path>/cases.jsonl PARITY_OUT=<path>/newapi-recorded.jsonl \
//	go test ./service -run TestRecordJudgeParity -count=1
//
// It calls the original JudgeIntelligenceHTML on every case and records its
// outputs. It is kept as .txt so it is not compiled in this module.
package service

import (
	"bufio"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestRecordJudgeParity(t *testing.T) {
	in, err := os.Open(os.Getenv("PARITY_CASES"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Skip("PARITY_CASES is not set")
	}
	defer in.Close()
	out, err := os.Create(os.Getenv("PARITY_OUT"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer out.Close()
	enc := json.NewEncoder(out)
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(in)
	scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 1<<20), 16<<20)
	for scanner.Scan() {
		var c struct {
			Case, Prompt, HTML string
			HTMLB64            string `json:"html_b64"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(scanner.Bytes(), &c); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		html := c.HTML
		if c.HTMLB64 != "" {
			raw, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(c.HTMLB64)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			html = string(raw)
		}
		got, err := JudgeIntelligenceHTML(c.Prompt, html)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := enc.Encode(map[string]any{"case": c.Case, "quality": got.Quality, "borderline": got.Borderline,
			"method": got.Method, "score": got.Score, "margin": got.Margin, "reason": got.Reason}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
